bulk.higherRangeRule: map base amount position in 100..600 to 600..1200; round nearest 50; clamp to product limits
bulk.unavailableRange: clamp each amount to product bounds; actual item amounts and range labels; no lower notice
bulk.labels: active range uses retained per-item previews; alternative range shows results of explicitly choosing that range

single.bounds: clamp presets to actual item limits and remove duplicate amounts
single.custom: 0..999999 whole rubles; empty disables Apply; out-of-bounds including zero remain applicable and clamp on confirmation

individualEditor.open: pencil on item discount or single-selection custom chip; temporarily extract item from background list into sheet
individualEditor.preview: same product identity and price as catalog; exact amount matching preset/input and limits
individualEditor.apply: save immediately; remove item from eligible list and selection; retain other selected items and range
individualEditor.cancel: discard draft and keep previous amount; Escape or backdrop also cancel; restore original item row, selection and scroll
individualEditor.delete: explicit separate action for existing discounts
individualEditor.keyboard: embedded numeric keypad; no group slider
individualEditor.empty: gray discount placeholder before input; primary text color for valid numeric preview
individualEditor.limits: tooltip above input: minimum or maximum; preserve typed value in preview; Apply and Save clamp to original product bounds without errors
individualEditor.clear: no clear-cross buttons; use keyboard deletion

bulkApply: save chosen results and clear selection; retain current tab and scroll; toast at top below navigation; hide eligible tab and show discounted only if none eligible remain
savedDiscounts: select saved items without changing amounts; individual editing and removal available; bulk range replaces chosen saved amounts only after Apply
realData: all counts derive from inventory, applied map and selection; landing inventory total11; prices and preview values share catalog source
limitations: deterministic recommendation demo; no AI backend
public browser blocked previously; publication verified with hosting MCP
selection: preserve per-item previews when selected, deselected or reselected; never recalculate existing selected amounts based on count
